<!-- Provenance of hook samples used by the product rules tests; maintainers must not mistake synthetic samples for live recordings. -->
# Hook fixtures

These are synthetic, sanitized protocol examples derived from the repository's Claude stream-json hook contract.
They are NOT recordings from a live CLI. A fresh real-hook recording is still required before ADR 0062e is certified.
No user prompt, transcript, absolute personal path or credential belongs in this directory.
